messages:
cs_jordan: Customer escalated — CSV export from Console (Analytics > Reports > monthly_usage) downloads as a 0-byte file when 'Group by' is set to a user/email string. Affects large orgs (~100k rows). Repro steps: 1) Set date range 2025-12-01 -> 2026-01-31; 2) Group by: `user.email`; 3) Click Export CSV -> downloaded file is 0 bytes. Customer workspace: org-7821. Impact: production, Dedicated.

qa_lee: I can repro locally on staging with a similar dataset. Export starts, then immediate download of 0 bytes. I captured export-service logs:
```
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z export-service INFO request received {workspace: org-7821, query_id: q_9f3}
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z export-service ERROR write failed: gzip: invalid stored block lengths
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z export-service WARN aborting stream and deleting partial object s3://exports/org-7821/q_9f3.csv.gz
```
Seems to be a gzip/streaming write error when the grouped cardinality is high.

eng-exports-bot: Noted: the gzip library was updated in the last release (deploy 1767769000) — see changelog entry: "upgrade gzip-streamer to v1.4.2".

devin: Thanks — can you paste a minimal curl we can use to hit the same endpoint (no real tokens in the thread)? Also, cc'ing infra/eng to see if recent change could cause a race.

cs_jordan: Sample repro curl (token redacted):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/exports \
  -d '{"workspace":"org-7821","report":"monthly_usage","group_by":"user.email","from":"2025-12-01","to":"2026-01-31"}'
```
Note: I will DM token to Devin. Customer is asking for ETA — they are on Dedicated with guaranteed export windows.

devin: Please DM the token, thanks. From the logs it looks like a write/gzip failure. If we can't fix immediately, we should provide a workaround: disable compression on export (serve raw CSV) or limit group_by cardinality in the UI until patch.

maria: I pulled the s3 object for a repro run: object exists with Content-Length: 0 and metadata indicates `Content-Encoding: gzip`. Hypothesis: the streaming gzip writer in v1.4.2 can hit an error path that returns before headers are flushed, leaving a zero-byte object and a `Content-Encoding` header — client then sees 0-byte download. Reverting the gzip-streamer is a likely quick mitigation.

maria: Proposed plan — 1) Rollback export-service to build `2026-03-16-rc.3` (pre-gzip-upgrade) across Dedicated region for org-7821 (30 min), 2) Push hotfix that adds safer gzip flush+retry, 3) Add unit tests for high-cardinality group_by streams. I can do step 1 if SRE approves.

sre-bot: Scheduled rollback deploy for export-service (target orgs: Dedicated) at 1767771200 UTC. Will perform during maintenance window and post status.

cs_jordan: Great — please confirm once rollback is done and I'll update the customer. Also logging note: customer reported exported file name was `monthly_usage__org-7821.csv.gz` but size 0.

devin: One more ask for repro: can QA attach a small csv of the user list (10k emails) that consistently repros so we can run integration tests?

qa_lee: Uploading a sanitized sample to the internal share: https://internal.redwood.ai/samples/export-repro/org-7821-users-10k.csv (:lock:) — contains no real PII.

cs_jordan: Thanks everyone — I'll hold customer update until SRE posts rollback success. :thumbsup:
